summary: Advance the plan to define a specific benchmark question. The previous loop failed to find sources comparing dynamic vs. static memory under fixed token budgets; this phase must target a reproducible benchmark to test the hypothesis.
body: The previous research loop (research-1789619937785) was closed because no inspected sources provided empirical comparisons between dynamic consolidation policies and simple baselines (e.g., append-only Markdown) under identical token budgets. The stopping rule (4 sources) was met, but the evidence requirement was not. Proceed to assign the manager to define a new bounded research question targeting a specific, reproducible benchmark (e.g., LongMemEval or MemoryAgentBench) that explicitly matches token budgets and compares success/hallucination rates. Limit to 4 sources. Do not implement.
